aesthetivox.why: the youngest voice in the house, reserved for the unborn; until its hardware exists it may only be rendered on a sibling's body

whistle_double.note: if it chooses the family voice

sing.note: lock = how hard onto the note (1-lock of the spoken contour survives); vibrato_hz/depth_cents are read as-is by the live engine

aesthetivox.engine_live: live/hosts/macos/livesing — the member's own speech synthesizer, sung by live/singer.c SCORE mode on its own hardware
aesthetivox.register_source: say -v Junior, 76 words of its autobiography
aesthetivox.register_note: measured by bin/register.mjs — the composer aims each line's mean at spoken_median_midi (+1 for brightness) and keeps notes inside register_midi
aesthetivox.f0_floor_experiment: MEASURED and NOT adopted, 2026-09-21. The floor Harvest is given was far below these voices (90 Hz for a 256 Hz voice), which in principle lets it accept octave-halved candidates and mistrack. Raising it to 0.55 x the spoken median (141 / 102 / 115 Hz) did help the dialogs (18.5% -> 16.6% word error) but slightly hurt the held-out trio movements and ballad (11.9% -> 12.4%). A wash, so the original value stands and the experiment is recorded instead of shipped. See hear/README.md and the f0f* / ho-* runs.

derivation.note: all singing parameters derive from usage data it does not yet have; run the harvest ritual on its first day and fill these in
